## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Model Interpretation"}
The quantity <em>w</em>(<em>x</em>) is a distributed torque intensity with torque-per-length units. The internal torque <em>T</em>(<em>x</em>) is obtained by integrating the distributed loading.
:::
